name: The Gilded Saloon
description: The Gilded Saloon opened in July 2025 as a joint venture between the Gilded Balloon, Paradise Palms and Kelburn Arts, but its name carries real weight in Edinburgh's comedy and arts scene: it's a direct tribute to the original Gilded Saloon, a beloved Cowgate performance bar destroyed in the catastrophic Cowgate fire of December 2002, which also burned down the entire Gilded Balloon venue and ten other Old Town businesses. The new bar, restaurant and 200-capacity performance venue overlooking Bristo Square revives the name more than two decades on, serving craft beer and pub food from local chef Tomas Gormley alongside a full comedy and arts programme.
interesting_fact: The original Gilded Saloon had itself replaced an earlier venue, the 369 Gallery, when that closed in the late 1990s - meaning the current bar carries the memory of a lineage of Cowgate arts venues stretching back decades, not just its immediate 2002-destroyed predecessor.
